note: Tag keys a shop record may carry. Each tag carries the source it came from. Ownership, community and welcome tags rest on the owner's own words, a press profile that names the owner, or a public directory. Tier cited = a named page; harvested = a public directory or list fetched by a tool; field = someone stood there. The validator refuses any tag at tier tradition or inference.

entries.label: Deli or bodega sandwiches
entries.evidence: the menu, a press piece naming the sandwich, or — for a harvested row — a shop that calls itself a deli or bodega in its own name. In New York that means a bacon egg and cheese on a kaiser roll; in California it usually means a donut-and-deli counter.
